description: This file defines the MetalTensorImpl class template, derived from OpaqueTensorImpl, specific to Metal backend support in PyTorch. It manages tensor metadata such as strides and provides overrides for tensor properties.

classes.name: MetalTensorImpl
classes.description: A template class for Metal backend tensors, inheriting from OpaqueTensorImpl, managing tensor strides and providing specific functionality for Metal tensors.

methods.name: strides_custom
methods.description: Returns the strides stored in the tensor.

methods.name: sym_strides_custom
methods.description: Returns the symbolic representation of the tensor's strides.

methods.name: sym_is_contiguous_custom
methods.description: Indicates whether the tensor is contiguous with the specified memory format.

methods.name: tensorimpl_type_name
methods.description: Returns the type name for this tensor implementation.
